description: TU Delft publishes GIS layers for North Sea infrastructure and related spatial allocations. Named subjects include petroleum blocks, oil and gas installations, cables and landings, pipelines, wind-farm areas and dedicated shipping routes. The custom time field gives 2000 to 2019, and the source lists shapefiles and QGIS files. Coverage: 2000/2019 Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: shapefiles, other stated files. Licence: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: Earlier transport-only rejection is superseded by explicit energy, communications and maritime infrastructure subjects under the current scope. Current asset completeness and operational status are unverified. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
